population_note: The 2024 census's counts for the region's 27 districts, added up.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the age group that holds the middle person, from the 2024 census's counts in the overlapping age groups it publishes (0-4, 0-17, 15 and over, 15-24, 18-30, 18 and over, 60 and over, 65 and over, 80 and over), differenced into disjoint ones (0-4, 5-14, 15-17, 18-24, 25-30, 31-59, 60-64, 65-79, 80 and over), added up over the units the population note names.
